_schema.description: Engines shown on the dashboards: the QVAC engine, the competitors of the campaign in comparisons.json and the engines of the comparison report imported by import-report.py. measured_on is filled by build-dashboard-data.py from the rows; details and source are the campaign's or the report's own words.

fields.engine: Engine name exactly as comparisons.json or report-rows.json spells it.
fields.role: QVAC engine, prior-report competitor or new competitor, measured.
fields.ggml: ggml-based or not, as a short phrase.
fields.details: Scope and caveats of the engine's rows.

rows.details: Weekly rows from the Sunday run of the engine master and ggml speech heads on every shared machine; campaign rows from the dated comparison at the build the campaign measured.
handy-computer/transcribe.cpp on Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 Q8_0, the same 11.0 s and 98.49 s clips as QVAC.
rows.source: QVAC speech engines report (Gustavo Araujo, 2026-10-01 edition)

rows.details: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 Q8_0 for ASR; Supertonic 3 Q8_0 and the Audio8 TTS Preview LM F16, Q8_0 and Q4_0 cuts for TTS, end-to-end process wall including model load on the same prompts as QVAC.
rows.source: QVAC speech engines report (Gustavo Araujo, 2026-10-01 edition)

rows.details: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 Q8_0 on the same clips as QVAC.
rows.source: QVAC speech engines report (Gustavo Araujo, 2026-10-01 edition)

rows.details: ACE-Step 1.5 Turbo with the same four model files as QVAC over ten fixed prompts; one prompt-set RTF and generation-time ratio per device.
rows.source: QVAC speech engines report (Gustavo Araujo, 2026-10-01 edition)

rows.details: The whisper.cpp bundled in the QVAC engine, driven through its resident C API and through whisper-server over HTTP in the report's Whisper small rows.
rows.source: Speech Bench comparison report of 2026-11-04 (Gustavo Araujo), copied by import-report.py

rows.details: Parakeet TDT and Nemotron rows of the report on Strix Halo and the RTX 5090 box; its Nemotron rows run a 160 ms streaming policy that the report keeps in its own chart.
rows.source: Speech Bench comparison report of 2026-11-04 (Gustavo Araujo), copied by import-report.py

rows.details: Upstream whisper-cli on Whisper small (Whisper tiny on Jetson Orin) in the report's resident-API rows.
rows.source: Speech Bench comparison report of 2026-11-04 (Gustavo Araujo), copied by import-report.py

rows.details: CosyVoice3 0.5B cloning from the b.wav reference in the report; its own frontend ONNX models, Q8_0 GGUF.
rows.source: Speech Bench comparison report of 2026-11-04 (Gustavo Araujo), copied by import-report.py

rows.details: Parler-TTS mini v1 on Strix Halo CPU in the report; the external T5 path failed its warmup.

rows.details: MiniMax Music3 10 s requests in the report, with a Flow-VAE codec unlike QVAC's DAC-style codec, so the ratio is a configured-deployment comparison.

rows.details: Whisper small on DGX Spark CUDA in the report.

rows.details: Whisper small over HTTP and the Nemotron plugin (offline API and HTTP) on DGX Spark in the report.

rows.details: Nemotron through the offline runner on the RTX 5090 box in the report; its ARM64 install failed on DGX Spark.
rows.source: Speech Bench comparison report of 2026-11-04 (Gustavo Araujo), copied by import-report.py

rows.details: The official MOSS-TTS v1.5 reference as a resident API on DGX Spark (CPU, CUDA F32 and configured pairs) and Strix Halo CPU in the report.
